Master.g1.label: Request submitted

intake.written_request_required.summary: A request must be in writing and delivered by U.S. mail, e-mail, hand delivery, or another method the governmental body has approved (e.g., fax, submission through its website).

Master.g1.city_config: Which channels the city actually operates (portal / form / paper / phone) — statute constrains, city chooses.

Master.g4.label: Acknowledgment auto-sent
Master.g4.city_config: Auto-acknowledgment text + send timing; statutory ack window where present, else city default (recommend: same business day).

Master.p3.label: Estimate Data

fee.estimate_and_notice.summary: If a copy charge (or a § 552.271 paper-inspection charge) will exceed $40, the body must give the requestor a written itemized statement detailing all estimated charges (including labor/personnel), notice of any less-costly alternative, and the requestor's response responsibilities.

The request is considered withdrawn if the requestor does not respond in writing within 10 business days after the itemized statement is sent (accepting charges, modifying the request, or filing an overcharge complaint).
fee.estimate_and_notice.clock_spec: 10 business-days from date the itemized statement is sent

fee.estimate_and_notice.summary: If, before making the copy available, the body determines estimated charges will exceed the itemized statement by 20% or more, it must send a written updated itemized statement; no timely response to the update means the request is withdrawn.

Master.p3.city_config: Which data points intake must capture to estimate (page count, media, labor class).

payment.deposit.summary: The officer may require a deposit or bond for unpaid amounts owed on prior requests if those unpaid amounts exceed $100, and this becomes the sole means of collecting those amounts.

payment.deposit_threshold.summary: The officer may require a deposit or bond for anticipated copy costs once an itemized estimate has been provided and the estimated charge exceeds $100 (body with more than 15 full-time employees) or $50 (fewer than 16 full-time employees).

Master.bv.label: VAGUE → Clarification
Master.bv.city_config: Vagueness screen wording; the reasonably-describes standard is statutory where present.

denial.no_responsive_records.summary: If the governmental body determines it has no information responsive to a request, the officer for public information must notify the requestor in writing not later than the 10th business day after the date the request is received.
denial.no_responsive_records.clock_spec: 10 business days from receipt of the request

Master.f2.city_config: Estimate-review $ threshold + reviewer role — pure city policy (recommend: supervisor review over $50).

Clarification.n2.label: Send clarification / assist request

clarification.clarification_process.summary: If a request is unclear the body may ask the requestor to clarify; if a large amount is requested the body may discuss narrowing the scope.
A written clarification/discussion request (or a request for additional info) must include a statement of the consequences of the requestor's failure to timely respond.

Clarification.n3.label: Await requester response

clarification.nonresponse_withdrawal.summary: If the body receives no written response by the 61st day after sending a clarification/discussion request (or additional-information request), the underlying request is considered withdrawn.

clarification.nonresponse_withdrawal.summary: If the body receives no written response by the 61st day after sending a clarification/discussion request (or additional-information request), the underlying request is considered withdrawn.

Clarification.close.city_config: Close-as-withdrawn notice; statutory consequence in MO/TX, city policy elsewhere.

Clarification.d4.label: Materially revised?
Clarification.d4.city_config: Materially-revised test (treat as NEW request → new clock, vs. continue) — pure city policy; recommend: new scope = new request.

eligibility.incarcerated_requester_exclu.summary: A governmental body is not required to accept or comply with a request from an incarcerated/confined individual or that individual's agent (other than the individual's attorney seeking disclosable information).

eligibility.any_person.summary: Any person may apply to the officer for public information and the officer shall promptly produce public information for inspection, duplication, or both.

eligibility.no_purpose_requirement.summary: The governmental body may not inquire into the purpose for which the requested information will be used.

eligibility.no_residency_requirement.summary: There is no residency requirement; the right to request runs to 'any person' regardless of residence.

Master.s1.label: Fee-waiver requested

fee.waiver.summary: The body must provide a copy without charge or at a reduced charge if it determines waiver/reduction is in the public interest because providing the copy primarily benefits the general public.
The body may waive the charge if the cost of processing the collection of the charge would exceed the amount of the charge.

Master.s1.city_config: fee_waiver approval module (v1, DESIGN_fee_waiver_commercial.md): enabled on/off governs the DISCRETIONARY program only — statutory-mandatory waiver categories fire regardless, on verified evidence. mode = intake_review (inline approve/deny) | routed_task {assignee_role, task_name}.

Master.s2.label: Commercial-rate requested
Master.s2.city_config: commercial_rate approval module (v1): same two modes as fee_waiver (intake_review | routed_task). Must decide at INTAKE — commercial classification changes the response clock in NJ (14-bd) and IL (recurrent/commercial track). Classification overriding a self-declaration is always communicated.

Clarification.deny.note: Deny-as-vague is narrower than reasonably-describes membership: TN·NJ·OH, OK only after SB 535 engagement (diagram legend, v2.2).

clarification.toll_on_clarification.summary: A governmental body's good-faith request for clarification tolls the 10-business-day period for requesting an attorney general decision until the requestor responds.
clarification.toll_on_clarification.clock_spec: tolls the 10 business-day AG-request clock (TX-0018) from clarification sent until requestor responds

The body may waive the charge if the cost of processing the collection of the charge would exceed the amount of the charge.

appeal.ag_referral_to_withhold.summary: A body that receives a written request for information it wishes to withhold under a Subchapter C exception must ask the attorney general for a decision, unless there has been a previous determination.

production.completion_window.summary: The officer must produce public information promptly, i.e., as soon as possible under the circumstances, within a reasonable time, without delay.
production.completion_window.clock_spec: undefined-soft: "promptly ... as soon as possible under the circumstances, that is, within a reasonable time, without delay" from request receipt

production.completion_window.summary: If information cannot be produced within 10 business days after receipt, the officer must certify that fact in writing to the requestor and set a date and hour, within a reasonable time, when it will be available.

If requested information is in active use or in storage and therefore unavailable when requested, the officer must certify this in writing and set a date and hour, within a reasonable time, when it will be available.

clarification.nonresponse_withdrawal.summary: If the body receives no written response by the 61st day after sending a clarification/discussion request (or additional-information request), the underlying request is considered withdrawn.
clarification.nonresponse_withdrawal.clock_spec: 61 days from date clarification/discussion request sent

clarification.toll_on_clarification.authority: City of Dallas v. Abbott, 304 S.W.3d 380 (Tex. 2010)
clarification.toll_on_clarification.summary: A governmental body's good-faith request for clarification tolls the 10-business-day period for requesting an attorney general decision until the requestor responds.
clarification.toll_on_clarification.clock_spec: tolls the 10 business-day AG-request clock (TX-0018) from clarification sent until requestor responds

payment.nonpayment_consequence.summary: A request is considered withdrawn if the requestor fails to inspect or duplicate the public information in the governmental body's offices on or before the 60th day after the date the information is made available, or fails to pay the postage and other applicable charges under Subchapter F on or …
payment.nonpayment_consequence.clock_spec: 60 calendar days from availability notice (inspection/duplication) or from charge notice (payment)

special_windows.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

response.catastrophe_suspension.clock_spec: Up to 7 consecutive days + one 7-day extension (max 14 calendar days per catastrophe); requests during suspension deemed received the first business day after it ends; pending-request clocks tolled

dup.bw.rate.label: Copy rate — B&W page
dup.bw.rate.unit: USD per page or part of a page, each recorded side a page (AG-established rate | municipal ceiling absent AG exemption = AG rate + 25%)
dup.bw.rate.authority: 1 Tex. Admin. Code § 70.3(b)(1); Tex. Gov't Code § 552.262(a)
dup.bw.rate.notes: Delegation followed: § 552.262 → 1 TAC § 70.3(b)(1) opened on the SOS TAC portal (last amended eff. Feb. 22, 2007). Municipal regime: § 552.262(a) lets a governmental body other than a state agency set its own charge up to 25 percent above the AG-established amount without an exemption (1 TAC § 7…

dup.color.rate.label: Copy rate — color page
dup.color.rate.unit: USD per page (no separate color rate; a color impression on paper up to 8 1/2 x 14 in. is a 'standard paper copy')
dup.color.rate.notes: Ch. 70 draws no black-and-white/color distinction; the definition of 'standard paper copy' turns on size and impression only, so the $.10 rate (with the 25% municipal variance) governs unless the copy is on specialty paper (§ 70.3(b)(2)(M), actual cost). Judgment on scope → medium.

dup.oversized.rate.label: Copy rate — oversized / nonstandard page
dup.oversized.rate.unit: USD per oversize paper copy (e.g., 11 x 17 in., greenbar, bluebar) — materials only (AG rate | municipal ceiling absent exemption)
dup.oversized.rate.authority: 1 Tex. Admin. Code § 70.3(b)(2)(L); Tex. Gov't Code § 552.262(a)
dup.oversized.rate.notes: Nonstandard-copy charges cover materials only; labor/overhead may be added where the request qualifies (§ 70.3(b)(2)). Maps/photographs on specialty paper are actual cost (dup.specialty.rate).

dup.specialty.rate.label: Specialty reproduction (photos, maps, transcripts)
dup.specialty.rate.unit: USD (specialty paper — Mylar, blueprint, blueline, map, photographic — and photographs/maps computed by the § 70.9 component tables)
dup.specialty.rate.notes: 'Actual cost' is defined at 1 TAC § 70.2(1) as 'The sum of all direct costs plus a proportional share of overhead or indirect costs.' Transcripts are not addressed by ch. 70 (court transcripts are outside the PIA). Microfiche/microfilm: cost of reproduction (§ 70.3(f)).

dup.tiers.label: Graduated page bands (per-page rate by volume)
dup.tiers.authority: 1 Tex. Admin. Code § 70.3(b)(1); Tex. Gov't Code § 552.261(a)
dup.tiers.notes: Coverage: Gov't Code ch. 552 subch. F, 1 TAC ch. 70 (§§ 70.1-70.13), 2026 PIA Handbook Part VII. No volume-graduated per-page bands exist; the per-page rate is flat. The only volume threshold (50 pages of paper records) switches labor/overhead on, not the per-page rate — see labor.billableWhen. N…

rules.freePages.label: Free page allowance per request
rules.freePages.notes: Coverage: ch. 552 subch. F, 1 TAC ch. 70, Handbook Part VII. No free-page allowance: the first 50 pages are still charged at the per-page rate; the 50-page rule only bars labor/materials/overhead. Free items are the § 552.232 certification, the § 552.261(b) labor statement, and inspection of pape…

labor.search.rate.label: Labor rate — search / retrieval ($/hr)
labor.search.rate.unit: USD per hour of actual time to locate, compile, manipulate data and reproduce (AG rate | municipal ceiling absent exemption = +25%)
labor.search.rate.authority: 1 Tex. Admin. Code § 70.3(d)(1); Tex. Gov't Code § 552.262(a)
labor.search.rate.notes: Delegation followed to 1 TAC § 70.3(d)(1). Chargeable only when the request qualifies (labor.billableWhen). Municipal regime: § 552.262(a) lets a governmental body other than a state agency set its own charge up to 25 percent above the AG-established amount without an exemption (1 TAC § 70.1(b)(2…

labor.review.rate.label: Labor rate — review / redaction ($/hr)
labor.review.rate.unit: USD per hour for REDACTION of mandatorily confidential information (AG rate | municipal ceiling); review to determine exceptions or to prepare an AG-ruling request: $0 (prohibited)
labor.review.rate.notes: Two-part item: exception REVIEW is never chargeable (Prohibition, TX-9010); REDACTION labor is chargeable at the general $15/hr rate (TX-9011), subject to the 50-page bar. Redaction under a discretionary exception is not addressed — treat as unresolved for that sub-case.

labor.programming.rate.label: Labor rate — programming / data extraction ($/hr)
labor.programming.rate.unit: USD per hour of programmer time to execute or create a program (AG rate | municipal ceiling absent exemption); computer resource charge separately at $10/CPU-min mainframe, $1.50/CPU-min midsize, $2.20/clock-hr client/server, $1.00/clock-hr PC/LAN
labor.programming.rate.authority: 1 Tex. Admin. Code § 70.3(c)(1), (h)(3); Tex. Gov't Code § 552.262(a)
labor.programming.rate.notes: Delegation followed. Non-programming data manipulation is billed at $15/hr (labor.search.rate). A § 552.231 written statement (20 days, TX-9038) is required when the request needs programming/manipulation and is infeasible or cost-conditioned.

labor.billableWhen.label: When labor is chargeable at all (never / always / only over N pages or N hours; paper-only scope)
labor.billableWhen.value: only_over_pages: 50 (pages of PAPER records) | exceptions: pages in two or more separate unconnected buildings, or in a remote storage facility | electronic-record copies: no page bar | inspection: paper — only § 552.271(c)-(d) cases; electronic — only if programming/manipulation
labor.billableWhen.unit: threshold in pages of paper records; scope enum
labor.billableWhen.notes: Fixed statutory bar the city cannot alter. Same-day requests from one individual may be aggregated toward the 50 pages (§ 552.261(e), TX-9028). Optional § 552.275 personnel-time limits (labor.periodicFreeHours) can make personnel time chargeable once a requestor's monthly/yearly limit is exceeded…

labor.overheadPct.label: Overhead / fringe surcharge on labor (%)
labor.overheadPct.unit: % of the labor charge (search/compile/reproduce and programming labor); not chargeable on 50-or-fewer-page paper requests or on inspection requests
labor.overheadPct.notes: Recovery of overhead is permissive ('may include'); once elected the methodology is fixed at 20% of labor. Overhead is not allowed on inspection requests (Handbook 2026 at 53-54).

labor.increment.label: Labor time increment + rounding
labor.increment.notes: Coverage: Gov't Code ch. 552 subch. F, 1 TAC ch. 70, 2026 Handbook Part VII and its worked examples (which bill in half-hour and quarter-hour amounts as illustrations only). No billing increment or rounding rule is stated; the rule speaks of 'actual time'.

rules.freeLaborHours.label: Free labor hours per request
rules.freeLaborHours.notes: Coverage: subch. F, 1 TAC ch. 70, Handbook Part VII. Texas has no per-request free labor hours: the labor gate is the 50-page paper threshold (labor.billableWhen), and § 552.275 operates per REQUESTOR per month/year (labor.periodicFreeHours), not per request. The prior's '15 hours / 36 hours' are…

labor.periodicFreeHours.label: Free personnel time per requestor per month/year (TX § 552.275 pattern)
labor.periodicFreeHours.engine_field: NOT IN ENGINE (fee_profiles gap — requestor-ledger counter)
labor.periodicFreeHours.unit: hours of uncompensated personnel time per requestor per 12-month period corresponding to the body's fiscal year | per one-month period — statutory minimums if the body elects to adopt § 552.275 limits
labor.periodicFreeHours.notes: Optional regime (Permission); if adopted, the city sets limits at or above the floors, must give a per-request written time statement (§ 552.275(d)), a cost estimate within 10 days once the limit is reached (TX-9030), and may withhold production until paid (TX-9031). Excluded time per 1 TAC § 70.…

rules.estimateNotifyThreshold.label: Itemized estimate / cost notice required above ($ or hours)
rules.estimateNotifyThreshold.unit: USD — written itemized statement of estimated charges required when the copy charge (or § 552.271 paper-inspection charge) will exceed $40
rules.estimateNotifyThreshold.notes: Fixed statutory trigger; failure to send the statement caps collection at $40 (1 TAC § 70.7(a), TX-9018). A separate, threshold-free statement applies to programming/manipulation requests (§ 552.231, TX-9038).

estimate.requesterResponseDays.label: Requester must respond to an estimate within N days (else withdrawn)
estimate.requesterResponseDays.unit: business days after the date the itemized statement is sent — no written response (accept / modify / AG overcharge complaint) = request withdrawn
estimate.requesterResponseDays.notes: 'Sent' and 'responded' dates defined in § 552.2615(e)-(f). Also applies to the updated statement (§ 552.2615(c)).

estimate.revisionNotifyPercent.label: Revised estimate required when actual exceeds estimate by N%
estimate.revisionNotifyPercent.unit: % — updated written itemized statement required when, before the copy is made available, estimated charges will exceed the prior statement by 20 percent or more
estimate.revisionNotifyPercent.notes: See payment.reissue for the collection cap that enforces it (§ 552.2615(d)).

estimate.validityDays.label: Estimate validity period (days)
estimate.validityDays.notes: Coverage: § 552.2615, § 552.263, § 552.221, 1 TAC § 70.7, Handbook Part VII. No estimate expiry/validity period exists. Related clocks: 10 business days to respond to the estimate (TX-0029), 60 days to pay accrued charges (TX-9022), and the estimate binds the final charge (§ 552.2615(d), TX-9019).

rules.deposit.threshold.label: Deposit / prepayment may be required above ($)
rules.deposit.threshold.unit: USD estimated charge that must be EXCEEDED before a deposit or bond may be required (bodies with more than 15 full-time employees | bodies with fewer than 16 full-time employees); itemized statement must have been provided first
rules.deposit.threshold.notes: Statute says 'exceed $100 / $50'; 1 TAC § 70.7(d) phrases it '$100 or more / $50 or more' — statute governs. Deposit may not be a down payment for future requests (TX-9026); documentation required (TX-9027).

rules.deposit.percent.label: Deposit capped at (% of estimate)
rules.deposit.percent.authority: Tex. Gov't Code § 552.263(a); 1 TAC § 70.7(d)-(e); 2026 PIA Handbook at 56
rules.deposit.percent.notes: For COPY requests neither the statute nor 1 TAC § 70.7 caps the deposit as a percentage of the estimate ('deposit or bond for payment of anticipated costs'); Handbook 2026 at 56 confirms the 50% cap is limited to 'inspection of paper records' (TX-9017). Coverage: § 552.263, § 552.271, 1 TAC § 70.…

payment.productionGate.label: Production may be conditioned on payment (pay before copies / pay in full before release)
payment.productionGate.value: copies_available_on_payment (charges accrue when the body advises the copy is available on payment; mailing conditioned on payment of postage and accrued charges) | deposit/bond before preparation permitted above threshold | after § 552.275 limit exceeded: no production until estimate paid
payment.productionGate.notes: Pay-before-release is the statutory shape for copies; inspection remains free (§§ 552.271-.272). Prior unpaid balance > $100 → deposit before preparing a new request (TX-9003).

payment.nonpayment.label: Nonpayment consequence (withdrawn after N days; prior-debt prepayment)
payment.nonpayment.value: withdrawn_after_days: 60 | prior_debt_prepayment_threshold_usd: 100 | deposit_nonpayment: withdrawn after 10 business days
payment.nonpayment.unit: calendar days after the requestor is informed of charges (or after records made available) | USD unpaid on prior requests permitting a deposit/bond and barring other collection | business days
payment.nonpayment.notes: TX-0035's clause is corrected to § 552.263(c) by TX-9003. School districts have an additional 180-day prepayment rule (§ 552.2661) — not municipal.

payment.depositClock.label: Statutory clock effect while a deposit is unpaid; grace; lapse action
payment.depositClock.value: clock_effect: request deemed received on the date the deposit/bond is received (Subchapters F and G clocks run from then) | grace: 10 business days | lapse_action: withdrawn | modified request after deposit demand = new request received on modification date
payment.depositClock.notes: Prior status pointed at TX-0035 (unpaid-balance deposit) — the clock rule is § 552.263(e)-(f). Handbook 2026 at 56 restates: 'If the requestor makes payment within the required time, the request is considered received on the date the payment is made.'

payment.reissue.label: Overrun re-issue rules (revised estimate required / blocks collection / restarts window)
payment.reissue.value: revised_estimate_required: yes at ≥20% overrun (before copy made available) | no response to update = withdrawn | collection cap: updated estimate, or 120% of original if no update sent (when actual > $40) | requester response window restarts: 10 business days from the updated statement
payment.reissue.notes: Handbook 2026 at 55: if the body fails to provide the updated statement, 'charges for the entire request are limited to the initial agreed-upon estimate plus 20 percent.'

rules.maxFee.label: Request-level ceiling (actual cost cap / statutory max)
rules.maxFee.value: charges may not be excessive and may not exceed the actual cost of producing the information | municipal charges ≤ AG amount + 25% (absent exemption) | actual charge over $40 ≤ (updated) estimate or 120% of original
rules.maxFee.notes: No dollar request-level maximum. Three ceilings stack: (1) actual cost / not excessive; (2) for non-state bodies, each AG-established component + 25%; (3) the itemized-estimate cap of § 552.2615(d). TX-9002 amends TX-0027 with the verbatim clause.

rules.deMinimis.label: De-minimis: no charge below ($)
rules.deMinimis.value: charge may be waived if the cost to the governmental body of processing the collection of the charge will exceed the amount of the charge
rules.deMinimis.notes: Discretionary; the de-minimis point is the city's own cost of collection, which the statute does not quantify. Coverage for a fixed dollar de-minimis: none in ch. 552, 1 TAC ch. 70 or the Handbook.

rules.minFee.label: Minimum fee
rules.minFee.authority: 1 Tex. Admin. Code § 70.3(b)(1); coverage: Tex. Gov't Code ch. 552 subch. F; 1 TAC ch. 70
rules.minFee.notes: Coverage: Gov't Code §§ 552.261-.275, 1 TAC §§ 70.1-70.13, 2026 Handbook Part VII. No minimum fee. '$.10 per page or part of a page' is a per-unit rounding rule, not a minimum charge. § 552.267(b) allows waiver of uneconomic charges (rules.deMinimis).

media.label: Electronic media (CD/DVD/USB) charge
media.value: CD-R/CD-RW 1.00 (1.25) | DVD 3.00 (3.75) | diskette 1.00 (1.25) | USB / other electronic media: actual cost | magnetic tape, data/tape cartridge, JAZ: actual cost
media.unit: USD per item — materials only (AG rate | municipal ceiling absent exemption in parentheses)
media.authority: 1 Tex. Admin. Code § 70.3(b)(2)(A)-(I); Tex. Gov't Code § 552.262(a)
media.notes: USB drives are not named in the 2007 rule; they fall under '(I) Other electronic media--actual cost'. Labor to copy to media is chargeable at $15/hr (Handbook 2026 example 2 at 52-53). No charge stated for e-mail delivery.

delivery.label: Delivery: mail / handling / email / pickup
delivery.value: postage/shipping: any related postal or shipping expenses necessary to transmit the information (actual cost) | e-mail: no charge stated | pickup: none | handling fee: none stated
delivery.authority: 1 Tex. Admin. Code § 70.3(j); § 70.10(9); Tex. Gov't Code § 552.221(b)(2)
delivery.notes: Mailing is conditioned on payment of postage (§ 552.221(b)(2), TX-9021). Referral to a URL is a permitted production method at no charge (§ 552.221(b-1)).

certification.label: Certification / certified-copy charge
certification.authority: Tex. Gov't Code ch. 552 subch. F; § 552.232(c); § 552.266; 1 TAC ch. 70
certification.notes: Coverage: Gov't Code §§ 552.261-.275 and 1 TAC §§ 70.1-70.13 contain no certified-copy or certification charge; the only certification the PIA mentions (§ 552.232(b), certifying prior production) is expressly free. § 552.262(a) yields to 'other law' that sets charges for specific kinds of informa…

av.label: Audio/video: per recording, per minute, free minutes
av.value: body-worn camera: 10.00 per responsive recording + 1.00 per full minute (no per-minute charge if identical footage already obtained by a member of the public) | other audio/video: media only — VHS 2.50, audio cassette 1.00, DVD 3.00, other electronic media actual cost, plus $15/hr labor where the request qualifies | free minutes: none
av.unit: USD per recording | USD per full minute | USD per media item
av.authority: 1 Tex. Admin. Code § 70.13(b) (delegated by Tex. Code Crim. Proc. art. 2B.0112(g), formerly Occ. Code § 1701.661(f)); 1 TAC § 70.3(b)(2)(G), (J), (K)
av.notes: Two regimes: body-worn-camera recordings from law enforcement agencies (municipal police included) have a fixed per-recording + per-minute schedule; all other A/V copies fall under the general § 70.3 media + labor rules with no per-minute or free-minute construct. Delegation followed: art. 2B.011…

commercial.label: Commercial-purpose schedule (surcharge %, labor becomes chargeable)

commercial.notes: Coverage: Gov't Code §§ 552.261-.275, § 552.222, 1 TAC §§ 70.1-70.13, 2026 Handbook Part VII. waiver.label: Fee waiver: grounds, mandatory vs discretionary, purpose statement, written denial, appeal
waiver.value: grounds: public_interest (MANDATORY once the body determines providing the copy primarily benefits the general public) | collection_cost_exceeds_charge (discretionary) | purpose_statement: not required — purpose inquiry prohibited (§ 552.222) | written_denial: not required (silent) | appeal: none for waiver decisions (AG overcharge complaint § 552.269 covers charge amounts only) | body-cam: agency may waive/reduce in public interest
waiver.notes: Handbook 2026 at 54: 'The determination of whether providing information is in the "public interest" rests solely with the governmental body whose records are requested.' § 552.275(i) preserves § 552.267 waivers within the personnel-time regime.

repeat.label: Repeat / aggregated requests (carry-forward, aggregation threshold)
repeat.value: same_day_aggregation: all requests received in one calendar day from an individual MAY be treated as one request for cost calculation (not across individuals for an organization) | repeat_request: free certification of prior production in lieu of re-copying | prior_unpaid > $100: deposit/bond before new request | § 552.275 cumulative personnel time per requestor per month/year
repeat.notes: No carry-forward of unused free allowance and no aggregation threshold beyond the same-calendar-day rule; the § 552.275 requestor ledger (if adopted) is the only cross-request counter.

fee.copy_rate_per_page.summary: The copy charge must be an amount that reasonably includes all costs related to reproducing the information, including materials, labor, and overhead.

fee.free_allowance.summary: For a request of 50 or fewer pages of paper records, the charge may not include materials, labor, or overhead and is limited to the per-page photocopy charge, unless the pages are in two-or-more unconnected buildings or a remote storage facility.

A body that sets time limits on uncompensated personnel time must allow at least 36 hours per requestor over a 12-month period and at least 15 hours per requestor in a one-month period before charging for personnel time.

fee.schedule_and_authority.summary: Charges for copies/inspection may not exceed the amounts established by attorney general rule; a non-state governmental body setting its own charges may not exceed the AG-established amounts by more than 25% absent an exemption.

custody.records_officer_designation.summary: A governmental body may designate one mailing address and one e-mail address for requests; if it posts/prints them, it need not respond to a request unless received at a designated address, by hand delivery, or by an approved (a)(4) method.
